sprints.title: Backend foundation
sprints.goal: Sharing schema on Supabase, tested in CI, with a script to check a real project.

commits.title: Add Supabase sharing migration, SQL tests and design docs
commits.tests: Share, join, cap of 10, code expiry, dependency rule in complete_task, stop_sharing.

commits.title: Replace the Spring Boot scaffold with Supabase-as-code
commits.tests: Migration bundler: order, headers, unchanged bodies, exit codes.

commits.title: Reject dependency cycles and early completions in share_trip
commits.tests: Self, direct and indirect cycles, diamond accepted, early completion rejected, table privileges.

commits.title: Add sprint plan and per-commit test registry
commits.tests: Plan is valid; every done commit has tests tagged with its ID; SPRINTS.md matches the plan.

commits.title: Add verify-remote script for a real Supabase project
commits.tests: Offline unit tests of the script's checks; the live run needs Adam's project URL and anon key.

commits.title: Write the backend README
commits.tests: README lists the commands that exist in package.json and contains no keys.

sprints.title: App domain and local storage
sprints.goal: Trips and tasks with prerequisites, saved on the phone, no UI yet.

commits.title: Add commit-ID test registry to the app repo
commits.tests: Every done app commit in the plan has a test whose name starts with its ID.

commits.title: Add Trip, Task and Place models with JSON round-trip
commits.tests: Round-trip, unknown fields kept, bad input rejected.

commits.title: Add DependencyGraph with cycle detection
commits.tests: Ready and blocked tasks, self, direct and indirect cycles, diamond.

commits.title: Add TripRepository with atomic writes and corrupt-file recovery
commits.tests: Save and load, interrupted write keeps the old file, corrupt file recovered from backup.

commits.title: Add TaskCompletionService for solo trips
commits.tests: Blocked task cannot be completed; completion is one-way and idempotent.

commits.title: Add versioned trip export and import format
commits.tests: Export then import gives the same trips; older format versions upgrade; bad files rejected.

sprints.title: App shell, trips and suggested order
sprints.goal: Create trips and tasks in the app and see a suggested visiting order.

commits.title: Add app shell: state management, theme and bottom navigation
commits.tests: Widget test of navigation between tabs; theme tokens match the design system.

commits.title: Add home trip list with empty, loading and error states
commits.tests: Widget tests for each state.

commits.title: Add create and edit trip form
commits.tests: Validation, save, cancel.

commits.title: Add trip details with locked-task state
commits.tests: A locked task shows 'Complete <name> first' and cannot be ticked.

commits.title: Add task form with a prerequisite picker that rejects cycles
commits.tests: Picker hides choices that would make a cycle.

commits.title: Add straight-line route provider and suggested order
commits.tests: Haversine distances, order respects prerequisites, distance only.

sprints.title: Map and places
sprints.goal: Pick places on a free map and search addresses.

commits.title: Add OpenStreetMap map widget with attribution
commits.tests: Widget test that attribution is always shown.

commits.title: Add place picker
commits.tests: Tap and drag set the place; radius is clamped.

commits.title: Add address search within the Nominatim usage policy
commits.tests: At most one request per second, identifying User-Agent, results cached (fake HTTP client).

commits.title: Add frequent places
commits.tests: Save, rename, delete, reuse in a task.

commits.title: Add trip map with task pins and states
commits.tests: Pin state follows task state (ready, locked, done).

sprints.title: Geofencing and reminders
sprints.goal: The phone reminds you when you arrive near a task.

commits.title: Add permission screens for location, notifications and battery
commits.tests: Each permission state (granted, denied, permanently denied) leads to the right screen.

commits.title: Add geofence service with region-limit handling
commits.tests: Nearest ready tasks are registered first when over the platform limit (fake geofence API).

commits.title: Add arrival notification and full-screen alert
commits.tests: Entering a region of a ready task notifies once.

commits.title: Add blocked dialog for arriving at a locked task
commits.tests: Arriving at a locked task names the prerequisite.

commits.title: Re-register geofences after reboot and app update
commits.tests: Restore from storage registers the same regions.

sprints.title: Trip Mode
sprints.goal: A focused driving screen with spoken prompts. No ETA or trip duration.

commits.title: Add trip status state machine
commits.tests: Allowed and rejected transitions between planned, active, paused and finished.

commits.title: Add Trip Mode screen with next task and distance
commits.tests: Shows next ready task and straight-line distance; never shows a time estimate.

commits.title: Add spoken prompts
commits.tests: Prompt text per event (fake text-to-speech).

commits.title: Offer Trip Mode when the phone connects to the car
commits.tests: Car connect event shows the prompt once per trip (fake Bluetooth).

sprints.title: Identity and sharing
sprints.goal: Share a trip with a code and join someone else's trip.

commits.title: Configure the Supabase client from build-time defines
commits.tests: Missing URL or key gives a clear error; nothing is read from files in git.

commits.title: Add anonymous sign-in and nickname
commits.tests: Nickname validation; session reused on restart (fake client).

commits.title: Add share trip flow and join code screen
commits.tests: share_trip payload matches the local trip; server errors map to messages.

commits.title: Add join by code
commits.tests: Code normalised; INVALID_OR_EXPIRED_CODE and TRIP_FULL shown as messages.

commits.title: Add stop sharing and the share error screen
commits.tests: Stop sharing keeps the local trip; NOT_ALLOWED after stop is handled.

commits.title: Apply the answers in QUESTIONS.md in a new migration
commits.tests: SQL tests for whatever is decided (input limits, task order, leave_trip).

sprints.title: Shared completion and offline queue
sprints.goal: Everyone on a shared trip sees completions live, also after being offline.

commits.title: Add shared trip details from get_trip
commits.tests: Snapshot mapped to the local model, both key styles accepted.

commits.title: Complete shared tasks through complete_task
commits.tests: BLOCKED shown as the locked-task message; repeat completion is harmless.

commits.title: Add live task updates
commits.tests: Incoming change updates one task; unknown task triggers a refetch (fake channel).

commits.title: Add offline completion queue with retry
commits.tests: Queued while offline, sent once online, kept across restart, dropped on NOT_ALLOWED.

sprints.title: Calendar and repeating trips
sprints.goal: Plan trips on dates and repeat them.

commits.title: Add repeat rules with next-occurrence calculation
commits.tests: Daily, weekly, monthly, end of month, time zone changes.

commits.title: Add calendar screen
commits.tests: Trips appear on the right days, including repeats.

commits.title: Add schedule sheet
commits.tests: Pick date, time and repeat; validation.

commits.title: Add date reminders for scheduled trips
commits.tests: Reminder scheduled and cancelled with the trip (fake notifications).

sprints.title: History and export or import
sprints.goal: See finished trips and move data between phones.

commits.title: Add history list
commits.tests: Finished trips listed newest first; filters.

commits.title: Add history details
commits.tests: Shows completed tasks with who and when completed them.

commits.title: Add export and import screen
commits.tests: Import preview, duplicate trips handled, bad file message.

sprints.title: Road distance
sprints.goal: Suggested order by road distance from a free source, straight line as fallback.

commits.title: Add road-distance route provider
commits.tests: Distance matrix parsed; order respects prerequisites (fake HTTP client). Source still to be decided.

commits.title: Fall back to straight-line distance on error or offline
commits.tests: Timeout, error and offline all fall back without blocking the UI.

commits.title: Cache road distances and limit requests
commits.tests: Same places reuse the cache; request rate stays within the source's limits.

sprints.title: Settings, legal and data deletion
sprints.goal: Settings, terms, privacy, delete all data, about.

commits.title: Add settings screen
commits.tests: Each setting saved and applied.

commits.title: Add terms, privacy and accounts-later screens
commits.tests: Screens open from settings and first run.

commits.title: Add delete_my_data function
commits.tests: Owner trips removed, participation removed, other users' data untouched.

commits.title: Add delete all data
commits.tests: Local files, geofences, notifications and the cloud record are removed.

commits.title: Add about screen with licences and map attribution
commits.tests: Version shown; OpenStreetMap attribution present.

sprints.title: First run and release
sprints.goal: Splash and welcome, final design pass, release build for Android.

commits.title: Add splash and welcome screens
commits.tests: First run shows welcome once; later runs go to home.

commits.title: Accessibility pass
commits.tests: Semantics labels on all actions; layouts hold at large text sizes.

commits.title: Match every screen state to the design
commits.tests: Golden tests for the main screens.

commits.title: Set release app ID, icon and version
commits.tests: Version in the app matches the sprint version.

commits.title: Add end-to-end smoke test
commits.tests: Create trip, add dependent tasks, complete in order, history.

sprints.title: iOS
sprints.goal: Run on iPhone. Testing on devices needs a Mac; App Store or TestFlight needs a paid Apple account.

commits.title: Add iOS permission texts and background modes
commits.tests: Info.plist keys present (checked in a test).

commits.title: Adapt geofencing and notifications for iOS
commits.tests: Platform-specific limits handled (fake platform).

commits.title: Add iOS build to CI
commits.tests: Debug build without signing passes on a macOS runner.
